verdict.rationale: Extend's Parse API outputs structured `chunks` plus a `metadata` object (extend-docs-3), and it has a dedicated Splitting feature (extend-docs-9) for breaking documents into segments — directly relevant to RAG-ready chunked output rather than a wall of text. However, evidence doesn't confirm the chunks are semantically-bounded or explicitly 'embedding-ready', and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of chunk quality for RAG use cases. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that chunk boundaries are semantic (not just page/section splits), confirmation of embedding-readiness, and independent user validation of RAG chunking quality.
